extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plans with the customer, who prioritized the lowest premium. The agent scheduled a plan review for 3 days from now.
composition.coaching_note: Marcus stated, 'Based on the CMS 2026 star ratings, this is the highest-rated plan in Pasco County.' However, this statement is flagged as materially misleading because it implies that the plan is the only highest-rated plan in the county, which is not substantiated. To improve, Marcus should rephrase this statement to accurately reflect the plan's rating.
